note: Shared installer-shape vectors for the cross-workspace contract. update-server's validateInstallerShape (src/artifact/validate.ts) and the client's private validateArtifact (dsh-plugin-huaanwork/src/update-download.ts) are independent implementations of the same criteria by necessity (no import may cross the workspace boundary), so both sides assert their verdict against these committed bytes. A change to a criterion on either side must update this fixture and both specs in the same commit.

sizeVectors.reason: an empty file is never a valid installer
one byte past the 1 GiB cap (the cap itself is inclusive)

files.name: mac-universal.dmg
files.construction: hand-crafted fat Mach-O (magic 0xcafebabe, x86_64 slice at 0x1000, arm64 slice at 0x2000, alignment 2^12) followed by a 512-byte trailer whose first four bytes are 'koly'. lipo -info reports both architectures, so this is the artifact the mac channel may publish (P1-1: mac is universal-only).

files.name: mac-thin-arm64.dmg
files.construction: hand-crafted thin Mach-O (magic 0xfeedfacf, cputype arm64), zero padding, then a 'koly' trailer. Passes the shape gate and must be refused by the mac-universal gate.

files.name: mac-truncated.dmg
files.construction: 100 bytes of deterministic filler: shorter than the 512-byte DMG trailer.

files.name: mac-bad-trailer.dmg
files.construction: 1024 bytes of deterministic filler plus a 512-byte trailer whose first four bytes are 'xxxx' instead of 'koly'.

files.name: windows-valid.exe
files.construction: 'MZ' at offset 0, uint32LE 0x80 at 0x3c, and 'PE\0\0' at offset 0x80 (deterministic filler elsewhere).

files.name: windows-bad-pe.exe
files.construction: 'MZ' at offset 0 and the 0x80 offset at 0x3c, but 'XXXX' where the PE signature belongs.

files.name: windows-pe-offset-past-eof.exe
files.construction: 'MZ' at offset 0 and an offset of 0x10000 at 0x3c, past the end of the file.

files.name: windows-truncated.exe
files.construction: 'MZ' followed by filler: shorter than the 64-byte DOS header.

files.name: windows-not-mz.exe
files.construction: deterministic filler starting with the ELF magic: no MZ header at all.
